sloka: महर्षिस्तमनादृत्य प्रविवेशाश्रमं तदा ।शापधारणभीतस्तु वाली विह्वलतां गतः ॥४-११-६३॥।।
transliteration: maharṣistamanādṛtya praviveśāśramaṁ tadā ।śāpadhāraṇabhītastu vālī vihvalatāṁ gataḥ ॥4-11-63॥।।

translations.english: 'The sage went into the hermitage without obliging Vali who became apprehensive of the curse of the sage.
